links.comparator_used: Locally trained models from scratch (including a local foundation model trained from scratch, and gradient boosting machines trained on all local data)
links.outcome: Sample efficiency / number of training examples needed to match fully trained GBM performance on 8 clinical prediction tasks
links.effect: FM SM with continued pretraining on local data required fewer than 1% of training examples to match the fully trained GBM, and was 60 to 90% more sample-efficient than training local foundation models from scratch; adapted off-the-shelf FM SM matched locally trained GBM on all data and gave a 13% improvement with few task-specific labels
links.quote: Continued pretraining on local data showed FM SM required fewer than 1% of training examples to match the fully trained GBM’s performance, and was 60 to 90% more sample-efficient than training local foundation models from scratch.

design_hint: local continued pretraining/adaptation of a shared foundation model before local use
